  1. DEFINITIONS

References to Schedules and Sections shall mean Schedules and Sections of this Agreement and, unless a contrary intention appears, references to persons shall include individuals, corporations, partnerships and unincorporated bodies of persons. When used in this Agreement, unless the contrary intention appears, the following words and expressions have the following meanings:

Agreement means this investment agreement and the Schedules hereto.

Articles of Association means the articles of association of the Company as amended from time to time.

Board means the board of directors of the Company.

Business Day means a day (other than Saturday, Sunday or a public holiday) on which the banks are open for routine business (i.e. not only Internet banking services) in Helsinki, Finland.

Closing has the meaning set out in Section 4.3.1.

Common Shares means the common shares in the Company.

Company has the meaning set out in Section 1.

Company’s Bank Account means the Company’s bank account number [IBAN] in [●] bank.

Compensatory Issue has the meaning set out in Section 6.3.1.

Compensatory Sale has the meaning set out in Section 6.4.1.

Disclosure Letter means the disclosure letter issued by the Founders and the Company to the Investors as at the Closing, attached hereto as Schedule 5.

Effective Date means the date of this Agreement.

[ESOP has the meaning set out in Section 4.2.]

Existing Shareholders has the meaning set out in Section 1.

Founders has the meaning set out in Section 1.

Investment has the meaning set out in Section 4.1.1.

Investors has the meaning set out in Section 1.

Loss has the meaning set out in Section 6.1.1.

Loss Amount has the meaning set out in Section 6.3.2.

Party has the meaning set out in Section 1.

Representations and Warranties means the representations and warranties set out in Section 5.

Sanctions means the economic or financial sanctions laws, regulations, trade embargoes, or other restrictive measures (including, but not limited to, those related to the financing of terrorism) that are enacted, administered, implemented, and/or enforced periodically by any of the following entities:

  1. the United Nations, and any agency or individual authorised by the United Nations to enact, administer, implement, and/or enforce such measures;
  2. the state of Finland and the European Union, and any agency or individual authorised by the state of Finland or European Union to enact, administer, implement, and/or enforce such measures; and/or
  3. the United States Government, including any department, division, agency, or office thereof, such as the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) of the United States Department of the Treasury, the United States Department of State, and/or the United States Department of Commerce.

Series Seed Shares has the meaning set out in Section 3.

Share means a share in the Company.

Shareholder means a person holding a Share in the Company.

Shareholders’ Agreement means the shareholders’ agreement relating to the Company.

Warrantors means the Company and the Founders.

Warrantors’ Knowledge means the actual knowledge of the Founders as well as what the Founders should have reasonably known after due inquiry.

  1. BACKGROUND

This Agreement contemplates a seed investment in the Company, whereby the Investors are willing to make an investment, which the Company and the Existing Shareholders are willing to accept, and issue new preferred series seed shares in the Company (the Series Seed Shares) to the Investors at the Closing (as defined below) on the terms and conditions set forth herein.

  1. INVESTMENT
    1. Investment

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the Investors undertake, severally and not jointly, to subscribe at the Closing for a maximum aggregate number of [●] new Series Seed Shares. based on the Company’s pre-money valuation of EUR [●], with a subscription price of EUR [●] per new Series Seed Share as follows (the Investment):

Investor New Series Seed Shares Total Subscription Price (EUR)

[Investor 1] [●] [●]

[Investor 2] [●] [●]

[Investor 3] [●] [●]

Total [●] [●]

The fully diluted shareholding of the Company before and after the Investment [(including the ESOP (as defined below))] is set out in Schedule 2.

Each Existing Shareholder and the Company hereby consents to the issue and allotment of the new Series Seed Shares as set forth in Section 4.1.1 and irrevocably waives any and all rights of pre-emption it may have under the Company’s Articles of Association, the Shareholders’ Agreement or otherwise in respect of the issue and allotment of the new Series Seed Shares contemplated by this Agreement.

The Parties undertake that all proceeds received from the Investment shall be used to [purpose]. None of the proceeds shall be used to satisfy any debts or other liabilities of the Company, other than the ordinary accounts payable and the Company’s legal costs associated with the Investment[, except as set out in Section 7.7]. No proceeds shall be used to pay placement agents or to make payments of any kind whatsoever to Existing Shareholders.

    1. Unanimous Shareholders’ Decision

The Existing Shareholders have passed a unanimous shareholders’ resolution deciding, inter alia, upon (i) the amendment of the Articles of Association establishing the Series Seed Shares, (ii) the issuance of a maximum aggregate number of [●] Series Seed Shares to the Investors, (iii) [the authorisation of the Board to issue a maximum aggregate number of [●] stock options entitling to a maximum aggregate number of [●] Common Shares for the creation of the employee stock option plan (the ESOP) and (iv)] the election of the members of the Board. A copy of the resolution, including the amended Articles of Association and the share issue terms, is attached hereto as Schedule 3.

    1. Closing

By signing this Agreement, the Parties confirm that the closing of the Investment (the Closing) has occurred and that the following actions have been carried out simultaneously:

  1. the Parties have signed this Agreement;
  2. the Existing Shareholders have decided on the Investment and the related matters as set out in Section 4.2 and in Schedule 3;
  3. the Parties have signed the Shareholders’ Agreement; and
  4. the Investors have subscribed for the Series Seed Shares issued in accordance with Section 4.1.

All deliveries made and actions taken at the Closing are deemed to have occurred simultaneously as a part of a single transaction, and no action is deemed to have been taken and no delivery is deemed to have been made until each of the above deliveries and actions are completed.

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, each Investor also undertakes, severally and not jointly, to pay in cash the subscription price for all Series Seed Shares subscribed by such Investor to the Company’s Bank Account within [20] Business Days from the Effective Date.

If an Investor does not pay the subscription price of the Series Seed Shares subscribed by it in full within [25] Business Days from the Effective Date, the Company may by written notice to the Investor in default cancel the Share subscription of such Investor without prejudice to the remedies available to the Company and the other Parties hereunder or under law.

    1. Undertakings after Closing

The Company shall file, and the Founders shall cause the Company to file, the amended Articles of Association and all other changes to be registered with the Finnish Trade Register as a result of the Investment without undue delay.

Each Party will execute, make and do all such assurances, documents, acts and things as may be necessary for effectively carrying out the terms of this Agreement. The Parties shall procure that the Company will comply with all its obligations hereunder.

  1. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
    1. General

The Company and each Founder, severally but not jointly, hereby represent and warrant to the Investors that, except as set forth in the Disclosure Letter, which exceptions shall be deemed to be part of the Representations and Warranties made under this Section 5, the following Representations and Warranties are true, correct and not misleading as of the Effective Date, except as otherwise indicated.

Based on the above, the Founders and the Company hereby represent and warrant to the Investors as follows:

    1. Organisation, Good Standing and Authorization

The Company is a company duly organised and validly existing under the laws of Finland. No order has been made and no resolution has been passed for or regarding the initiation of any bankruptcy, restructuring, winding up or liquidation proceedings of the Company, and no meeting has been convened and no petition has been presented for such purpose or to the Warrantors’ Knowledge, is threatened.

Each Founder and the Company has the necessary power, authority and approval, corporate or otherwise, to enter into this Agreement and to execute, deliver and perform this Agreement and to consummate the transactions contemplated herein. This Agreement has been duly executed and delivered by each of the Founders and the Company and constitutes valid and legally binding obligations enforceable against each of the Founders and the Company in accordance with its respective terms.

    1. Capitalization

The list of Shareholders and holders of other equity securities (existing on the Effective Date prior to the Investment) and the number of Shares and other equity securities held by them as listed in Schedule 2 are correct and up-to-date. There are no other Shares or other equity securities other than those specified in Schedule 2. All the outstanding Shares have been legally and validly issued and are fully paid up. To the Warrantors’ Knowledge, none of the Shareholders has agreed to sell, transfer or otherwise dispose of, or create any encumbrance over, his/her/its Shares (or any interest therein). No share certificates or interim certificates for the Shares or equity securities have been issued.

There are no outstanding obligations, warrants, options, special rights, subscriptions, right of first refusal, pre-emptive rights, contracts or agreements to which the Company or the Founders are bound providing for the issuance of any additional Shares or encumbrance whatsoever or any other rights to the Shares in the Company except (i) as provided for in the Shareholders’ Agreement, and (ii) as disclosed in the capitalization table attached hereto as Schedule 2. There are no declared but unpaid dividends by the Company.

    1. Liabilities

The Investors have been presented with a true and fair view of the financial condition, the assets and liabilities (including provisions for all warranty claims and for bad and doubtful debts) of the Company. There are no liabilities (whether actual or contingent and whether on- or off- balance sheet) of the Company which relate to any fact, occurrence or event before the Effective Date other than liabilities disclosed or provided for in the audited annual accounts of the Company and liabilities arisen in the ordinary course of business conducted in accordance with sound and prudent business practice taking into consideration the overall business environment and economic conditions and in compliance with the applicable laws, and always on an arm’s length basis.

    1. Nature of Disclosure

To the Warrantors’ Knowledge, there is no material fact, occurrence or circumstance relating to the affairs or business of the Company which has not been disclosed to the Investors and which might reasonably be expected to influence the decision of a prudent investor as to whether to enter into the Agreement, invest in the Company or the terms on which a prudent investor would enter into the Agreement or invest in the Company. The information provided by the Company and the Founders to the Investors has been true, complete and accurate in all material respects and no other matter which renders any such information misleading exists.

    1. Intellectual Property Rights

The intellectual property rights of the Company comprise all such rights necessary to permit the operation of the business of the Company as now being conducted. The Company holds exclusive title and all the transferable rights (including rights to transfer, assign, modify and further develop such rights and create derivative works thereof) to the works performed by its employees and/or created by its subcontractors. The Company has no further financial obligation to such employees or subcontractors arising out of or in connection with such works or services performed for the Company.

The intellectual property rights and the conduct of the business and activities of the Company to the extent and in the manner it is, was, or is contemplated to be conducted did not, do not and will not, before or after the Closing (i) infringe or misappropriate the rights to intellectual property rights of any third party, (ii) violate the rights of any third party (including rights to privacy or publicity), or (iii) constitute unfair competition or trade practices under the laws of any jurisdiction. The Company has not received any notice from any third party claiming or alleging any such infringement, misappropriation, or violation, and there are no valid grounds for any bona fide claims by any third party alleging such infringement, misappropriation or violation. The Company is not in possession of any formal report or opinion indicating that any third party is infringing or misappropriating the intellectual property rights of the Company.

The business of the Company, products delivered or services rendered by the Company do not violate or infringe any open source licenses or free software licenses.

The rights, interests and title in and to all the domain names used in the business of the Company shall vest exclusively in the Company.

All software and computer equipment used, possessed, owned, leased, or hired by the Company are sufficient for the purpose of conducting the Company’s operations as currently conducted. The Company has the necessary and required software licenses and such software licenses are valid, enforceable and binding on the Company and the Company in compliance with all the terms and conditions of such licenses. No amount is outstanding or due and payable on any license on the Effective Date. No software or computer equipment used, possessed, owned, leased or hired by the Company is unauthorised or not validly licensed.

    1. Contracts

All transactions of the Company have been made on an arm’s length basis, on sound commercial terms and bona fide for the operations of the Company.

All agreements to which the Company is a party, written and/or oral, are in full force and effect under their respective terms and neither the Company nor, to the Warrantors’ Knowledge, any of the counterparties is in material default thereunder. No event, occurrence, condition or act has occurred which, whether with or without notice, lapse of time or both, would constitute a default or event of default by the Company or, to the Warrantors’ Knowledge, any of the counterparties with respect to any such term or provision of any such agreement. No notice of termination or of the intention to terminate has been received or given in respect of any agreements and, to the Warrantors’ Knowledge, there are no grounds for prematurely terminating, rescinding, rendering void or adjusting any such agreements.

The Company is not, and due to the Investment will not be, in breach or in default of any loan agreement including any financing agreement with any governmental financing agencies (such as Business Finland or Finnvera).

The Company is not bound by any agreement or other arrangement that would be breached by this Agreement or contains a provision providing the counterparty, upon the execution of the Investment or a part of it, the right to (i) terminate such agreement or other arrangement, (ii) modify its obligations, or (iii) otherwise trigger consequences which are adverse to the Company.

    1. Compliance with Law; Sanctions

The Company has been in compliance, in all material respects, at all times with all laws and regulations applicable to it, in particular personal data protection laws and laws and regulations regarding anti-money laundering and trade restrictions. No notices or claims have been received by the Company or, to the Warrantors’ Knowledge, are threatened against the Company, asserting the Company’s violation of, liability for or potential responsibility under any applicable law, regulations or any authorisations, approvals, consents, permits or licenses.

Neither the Company nor any Founder is a designated target of or otherwise subject to Sanctions (including, without limitation, as a result of being owned or otherwise controlled, directly or indirectly by any individual or entity who is a designated target or otherwise subject to Sanctions).

    1. Employment Matters

The Company has at all times complied with all employment agreements (including with respect to terminations thereof) and any and all applicable laws, regulations, policies and collective bargaining agreements with respect to its employees, data protection and safety and health matters. The Company has not received notice, that remains current, of any claim that they have not complied with any employment, labour, data protection, safety and health regulations or related laws, regulations, policies or collective bargaining agreements.

The Founders do not have material secondary occupations.

All employment agreements of the Company have been entered into on terms customary for the industry and do not provide for exceptional benefits to the employees or exceptional liabilities on the Company.

    1. Litigations

There are no pending or, to the Warrantors’ Knowledge, threatened claims, disputes, litigations or other proceedings involving the Company.

There is no action, suit, investigation or proceeding before any court or by or before any governmental body or arbitration tribunal pending against the Company or, to the Warrantors’ Knowledge, any proceeding threatened against the Company.

    1. Taxes

The Company has (i) filed all necessary tax returns by the required deadlines, (ii) paid or accrued all taxes shown to be due on such returns, and (iii) paid or accrued all taxes for which a notice of assessment or collection has been received, and there are no pending tax audits of the Company, and no tax authority has asserted or demanded any claim for taxes based on a tax audit.

The Company has withheld, collected and paid over to the appropriate authorities all taxes and similar payments (including, but not limited to, employer and pension insurance payments) required by law to be paid, withheld or collected.

  1. COMPENSATION AND LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY
    1. General

The Investors are entering into this Agreement in reliance upon each of the Representations and Warranties under Section 5 being true, correct and not misleading on the Effective Date. The Warrantors undertake to indemnify and compensate the Investors severally but not jointly for any direct losses and any reasonably foreseeable (as of the Effective Date) indirect losses the Investors may suffer, including any damage occurring to the Company (in which case each Investor's Loss shall be determined in accordance with Section 6.1.3), should any of the Representations and Warranties turn out to be untrue, incorrect or misleading on the Effective Date (a Loss).

Unless a breach of the Representations and Warranties is attributable to fraud or gross negligence on the part of a Founder, in which case the Investors shall be entitled to claim compensation directly from such Founder without first seeking recovery from the Company, the Company's liability under this Section 6 shall be primary and the Founders' liability shall be secondary. Accordingly, the Investors shall first seek recovery from the Company in respect of any Losses, and the Founders shall have no liability in respect of any Losses unless and until (a) a valid claim has been notified to the Company in accordance with this Section 6, (b) the Company has failed to satisfy such Losses in full within [30] Business Days of such notification, and (c) the Investors have taken all reasonable steps to enforce and recover such Losses from the Company. The liability of each Founder under this Section 6 shall in all cases be subject to the limitations set out in this Section 6.

If such damage has occurred to the Company, each Investor shall be deemed to have incurred damage equalling the total amount of the damage multiplied by such Investor’s fully-diluted ownership percentage in the Company.

    1. Limitations of Liability

The Warrantors’ total liability to the Investors for a breach of the Representations and Warranties shall not exceed the amount invested pursuant to this Agreement. The Company’s liability to an Investor for a breach of the Representations and Warranties shall not exceed the amount invested by such Investor pursuant to this Agreement, and the Founders’ aggregate liability to an Investor for a breach of the Representations and Warranties on a pro rata basis shall not exceed [30]% of the amount invested by such Investor pursuant to this Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, the Founders' liability under this Section 6.2.1 shall only arise to the extent that the Company has failed to satisfy the relevant Losses in accordance with Section 6.1.2. The aggregate compensation to an Investor shall not exceed the amount invested by such Investor pursuant to this Agreement.

The Warrantors shall not be liable in respect of any individual claim for breach of the Representations and Warranties where the amount of such claim is less than EUR [5,000], and such claim shall not be taken into account for the purposes of calculating the basket referred to below. The Warrantors shall not be liable in respect of any claim or claims for breach of the Representations and Warranties unless the aggregate amount of all such claims (excluding claims below the de minimis threshold) exceeds EUR [20,000], in which case the Warrantors shall be liable for the full amount of such claims and not merely the excess over such threshold. Any claim for a breach of the Representations and Warranties set out in Section 5 shall be made within eighteen (18) months of the Effective Date. No limitations of liability set out in this Agreement shall apply to intentional or grossly negligent breaches of the Representations and Warranties.

The Warrantors’ Representations and Warranties under Section 5 are the sole and exclusive representations and warranties, and no Party may rely on any other representations, warranties or guarantees whatsoever, whether implied or arising out of the applicable legislation, unless expressly set out in this Section 6. For the avoidance of doubt, the Company and/or the Founders may not rely on any representations or warranties whatsoever given by the Investors.

Except for the Representations and Warranties set out in Sections 5.2 and 5.3, all of the Representations and Warranties shall be qualified by any fact, matter, event, circumstance or other matter fairly disclosed in the Disclosure Letter. Accordingly, except for the Representations and Warranties set out in Sections 5.2 and 5.3, the Company and the Founders shall not be deemed to be in breach of the Representations and Warranties to the extent a fact, matter, event or circumstance is fairly disclosed to the Investors in the Disclosure Letter.

    1. Compensatory Issue

Should the Company be liable to compensate an Investor under this Section 6, such Investor shall, at its sole discretion, be entitled to request such compensation to be paid, in whole or in part, by way of issuance of new Series Seed Shares for subscription by such Investor in accordance with this Section 6.3 (the Compensatory Issue).

The number of new Series Seed Shares to be issued in a Compensatory Issue shall be calculated by dividing the amount to be compensated by the Company to such Investor in the form of Series Seed Shares (the Loss Amount) by a price per Series Seed Share, which shall be calculated by subtracting the Loss Amount from the pre-money valuation of the Company used in the Investment and dividing the result by the total number of shares in the Company on a fully diluted basis immediately prior to the Investment. The subscription price payable by the relevant Investor in the Compensatory Issue shall be set off against the Loss Amount payable by the Company to such Investor.

    1. Compensatory Sale

Should a Founder be liable to compensate an Investor under this Section 6, such Investor shall, at its sole discretion, be entitled to request such compensation to be paid, in whole or in part, by way of sale of the Common Shares held by such Founder (the Compensatory Sale). Such Common Shares shall be converted into Series Seed Shares simultaneously with such transfer. The number of Shares to be transferred and the price to be used shall be determined following the principles set out in Section 6.3.2.

Each Party undertakes to execute, make and do all such resolutions, documents and acts as may be necessary to effectively complete a Compensatory Issue and a Compensatory Sale in accordance with Sections 6.3 and 6.4.

  1. MISCELLANEOUS
    1. Confidentiality

Section [11] (Confidentiality) of the Shareholders’ Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis to this Agreement.

    1. Amendment; No Waiver

Any amendments to this Agreement may be made only in writing and signed by the duly authorised representatives of the Parties. Any other amendments shall be void.

Any failure or delay by a Party in exercising any right or remedy will not constitute a waiver. No waiver of any term or condition of this Agreement or of any right or remedy arising in connection therewith shall constitute a waiver of any successive breach of such provision or a waiver by such Party of any other provision of this Agreement.

    1. Notices

All notices and other communications given or made pursuant to this Agreement shall be in English, in writing and shall be deemed effectively given upon the earlier of actual receipt or:

  1. when delivered personally to the Party to be notified;
  2. once sent, if sent by email during normal business hours of the recipient, and if not sent during normal business hours, then on the recipient’s next Business Day; or
  3. five (5) Business Days after having been sent by registered or certified mail, return receipt requested, postage prepaid.

All communications shall be sent to the respective Parties at their address as set forth in the “Parties”- Section of this Agreement or to such address as subsequently notified by a respective Party by a written notice and such notice shall be deemed given when received by the other Parties in accordance with this Section 7.3.

    1. Entire Agreement

This Agreement and the documents referred to herein, together with all the Schedules hereto, constitute the entire agreement and understanding of the Parties with respect to the subject matter of this Agreement, and supersede any and all prior understandings and agreements, whether oral or written, between or among the Parties hereto with respect to the specific subject matter hereof.

    1. Severability

If any provision of this Agreement shall be found by any court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid or unenforceable, the Parties hereby waive such provision to the extent that it is found to be invalid or unenforceable. Such provision shall, to the maximum extent allowable by law, be modified by such court so that it becomes enforceable as close to the original provision as possible, and, as modified, shall be enforced as any other provision hereof, all the other provisions hereof continuing in full force and effect.

    1. Assignment

This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the Parties and their respective legal successors and permitted assigns and nothing in this Agreement, express or implied, shall constitute any rights or remedies to any third parties under this Agreement.

Any purported assignment, transfer, delegation or sublicensing of any rights, duties or obligations arising under this Agreement shall be void, except where made in connection with a transfer of Shares permitted under the Shareholders’ Agreement.

    1. Expenses

Each Party shall bear its own advisors’ fees, costs and expenses in full. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company shall reimburse the Investors' legal counsel for reasonable out-of-pocket fees and disbursements incurred in connection with the Investment, up to a maximum of EUR [●] (excluding VAT).

    1. Interpretation

The Parties and their respective advisers have participated jointly in the negotiation and drafting of this Agreement. If any ambiguity or question on intent or interpretation arises, this Agreement shall be construed as if drafted jointly by the Parties, and no presumption or burden of proof shall arise favouring or disfavouring either Party by virtue of the authorship of any of the provisions hereof.

The headings and the table of contents of this Agreement are for convenience of reference only and do not in any way limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of the provisions of this Agreement.

    1. Governing Law

This Agreement, including the arbitration clause, and any dispute, claim or controversy arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach, termination or validity thereof, are governed by the laws of Finland without regard to its principles and rules on conflict of laws.

    1. Arbitration

Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach, termination or validity thereof, shall be finally settled by arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration Rules of the Finland Chamber of Commerce. The number of arbitrators shall be one (1). The seat of arbitration shall be Helsinki, Finland. The language of the arbitration shall be English. However, evidence may be submitted and witnesses may be heard in Finnish, to the extent that the arbitral tribunal deems it appropriate.

  1. AGREEMENT COPIES

This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts and all of the counterparts taken together shall be deemed to constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page to this Agreement by email or execution by means of electronic signatures shall be as effective as delivery of a manually executed counterpart of this Agreement.
